title: 100% worth it
text:
We had an absolutely fantastic experience on our Via Ferrata tour with Harry! He was incredibly knowledgeable and educational, with a strong focus on safety throughout the entire experience. He took the time to thoroughly explain not only what we needed to do, but why we did things a certain way, which made us feel confident, comfortable, and well-prepared. On top of that, he was genuinely kind, patient, and personable.

We couldn’t have asked for a better guide! I would highly recommend that everyone book a tour with Harry. You won’t be disappointed!
author: erinv582

title: The best way to discover a via ferrata
text:
This Saturday Mario and I were lucky enough to do a via ferrata with Harry and we can only say that it was an incredible experience.

From the first minute he gave us confidence and security. The entire route was perfectly organized and at each section he explained in detail what we were going to do, how to face each step, and made us enjoy the activity with total peace of mind.

It is clear that Harry is a true mountain lover, and he manages to pass that passion on to those who accompany him. He not only guides you, but he makes you feel and experience the mountain in a very special way.

Fur

title: An unforgettable experience
text:
From start to finish Marydee and Harry have been very nice. 

We did the John Hogbin ferrata track in Zafarraya with Harry, who was telling us curiosities of it, also clear, to give us the proper indications of safety and how to get around the different points of the route. He is a person with a total vocation in his work.

Then at the picnic besides being super-rich what one of her daughters prepared, we had a very close and welcoming time.

We will definitely repeat!!!! We loved the experience

title: Caminito del Rey, Via Ferrata, Rio Verde Canyoning
text: Three spectacular days, we have spent with Dim Trap, all thanks to the confidence conveyed by the guide Harry, who explains so calmly and positively that one ends up doing the routes believing himself a sportsman and overcoming fears. Very good experience all positive and the toast that offer at the end a wonder, thank you very much to all your team for sure we repeat.
author: 830olis

text:
An unforgettable family experience!
We were lucky enough to experience several adventures with this Enterprise, including the Caminito del Rey, the Via Ferrata de Zafarraya and canyoning on the Río Verde. Despite not being sportsmen, everything was perfectly adapted to enjoy as a family. Our guide, Harry, was exceptional: very patient, with great experience and always attentive that we were all safe and enjoying ourselves to the fullest. Definitely one of the best family experiences we have ever had. We'll repeat!
author: 121gabrielantoniog

text: It’s an incredible experience, they are activities to do as a family, we did: King’s walk, Via ferrata Zafarraya and green river canyoning; all three exceeded our expectations. Thank you Harry, Mary and the entire Dimtrap team for organizing this experience, taking care of every detail so we were always at ease. Super recommended, we have a nice memory.
